title: Oven-Roasted Syrian Meat Pilaf
description: A spicy Syrian dish featuring crispy meat and a flavorful pilaf, perfect for serving in a dolsot stone bowl.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb pieces and toss to coat with spice mixture.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Transfer lamb to a large baking dish and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the Korean chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the pilaf rice to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add chicken broth, beef broth, and cooked lamb to the skillet. Stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the baking dish with the lamb and stir to combine.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the meat is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Stir in hoisin sauce and serve hot in dolsot stone bowls.
